title: THE PORTION EAST OF THE JORDAN

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon, and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites. It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maakah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salekah - Josh 13:9-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter now begins carefully detailing the land east of the Jordan — the towns, the plateau, the borders, region by region. To us these ancient place names may mean little, but to the tribes receiving them, each name was home. This gorge, that plateau, these towns — every one would become a place where families lived, children grew, and God was worshipped.

God's attention to detail here is worth noticing. He does not hand out the inheritance in vague blocks; He specifies boundaries with care. Our God is not careless with His people. He assigns each portion deliberately, knowing exactly what each tribe needs. The same God who set these ancient borders is the God who determines the times and places of our lives (Acts 17:26).

There is quiet comfort in that. Your circumstances, your season, the particular "portion" of life God has placed you in — none of it is random. He has marked out your boundaries with the same care He gave to Israel's tribes. Even the hard borders, the limitations we would not have chosen, are within His wise assigning. We can trust the God who says, "The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places" (Ps 16:6), even when we cannot yet see why.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe the "portion" of life God has given you is deliberate, not random?
- How does God's careful assigning of boundaries comfort you?
- Are there limitations you need to trust as part of His wise design?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You assign my portion with care and set my boundaries in wisdom. Help me to trust that even my limits are within Your good design. Amen.
